scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p helper/tsconfig.json && node scripts/vendor.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs helper/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.package: npm run package:backend && electron-packager . CoderFleet --no-asar --icon=icons/coderfleet --out out --ignore='^/(src|helper|test|out|scripts|backend|icons|installer|release|\.cache|tsconfig.json|node_modules)'
scripts.package:backend: npm run build && node scripts/package-backend.mjs --arch x64 && node scripts/package-backend.mjs --arch arm64
